clip-cost: What did charging your Rivian cost this month?
Rivolt adds up the charges it can price. Estimates are marked, unpriced ones are listed.
Home, away and fast charging, each with its own cost.
Each price shows its source: what Rivian billed, your rate, or a labelled estimate. Unpriced charges are flagged, not guessed.
If you have off-peak hours, it shows what moving charges into them could have saved (estimate).

end: rivolt.dev · free during the beta · open source

clip-share: Want to post what your month looked like?
The card shows kWh and miles. Cost stays off unless you switch it on.
No places, no VIN, no map. Made on your device; Rivolt posts nothing.
Save it or share it wherever you like.

end: rivolt.dev · free during the beta · open source

Miles, total time, charging time and an estimated cost for the whole trip.
